user.title: Connect Albert Heijn
user.description: Open this Albert Heijn login URL in your browser: {login_url}\n\nSign in with Albert Heijn. When the browser redirects to appie://login-exit, copy the authorization code or complete redirect URL and paste it below. Authorization codes are single-use; obtain a fresh code for every attempt.

data_description.authorization_code: Paste the value from the code parameter, or the complete appie://login-exit?... URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Albert Heijn
reauth_confirm.description: Open {login_url}, sign in, and paste the returned appie:// URL or authorization code.

error.invalid_auth: Albert Heijn did not accept this authorization code. Obtain a fresh code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Albert Heijn shopping-list API. Check the Home Assistant log for the exact API error.

abort.already_configured: This AH account is already configured
